title: Report per-launch timings when a Windows exchange policy fixture group hits its Deadline
outcome: Report per-launch timings when a Windows exchange policy fixture group hits its Deadline
acceptance: When a Windows exchange policy fixture group exceeds its supervisor deadline, the test failure names each launch completed so far with its elapsed time and the launch that was running at the deadline, instead of only Err(Deadline).

The captured output of a launch that hits Err(Deadline) is kept for the failure report rather than dropped, and a focused test proves the report on a forced deadline; what the fixture groups prove (bounded launch workload, refusal semantics) is unchanged.

completion.summary: Windows exchange policy and configuration supervisor failures now retain bounded pre-deadline output and report completed launch durations plus the captured active/unknown launch state. Production errors and default deadlines remain unchanged. Landed, pushed and installed after full gate, independent review pair, acceptance 2/2 and all five live-store readiness checks.
